skills.name: Freezing Bullet
skills.description: Fires freezing bullets from afar with his rifle. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy buffs  *Enemy Evade Rate -30% (7 sec) *ATK x 4000% Area Damage

skills.name: More! I Need More Power!
skills.description: Focuses the mind and releases power. Good effects on allies.  *Hit Rate +40%  (7 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +40% (7 sec) *ATK Speed +140% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Kaiju No. 8
abilities.description: Kaiju No. 8 Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Persistence
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability have a high chance of activating Persistence when defeated. Persistence allows these Rangers to hold on for 7 more seconds with a big ATK increase.
